sentences.zh: 在活动中，她有机会遇到一个叫詹姆斯·奥基夫的人，他运营着一个名为“真理项目”的机构，这是一个右翼的、带有设局性质的新闻机构。

sentences.en: And she runs him down and she says, you don't know who I am, but you should because I'm going to make a big difference and I'm going to be really important.
sentences.zh: 她追上了他并说，你不知道我是谁，但你应该知道，因为我要做出改变，而且我会变得非常重要。

sentences.en: And he kind of laughs it off, but has her number.
sentences.zh: 他笑了笑，但记下了她的电话号码。

sentences.en: And a few months later, he gives her a call and invites her to come up to New York and sort of prove what she can do.
sentences.zh: 几个月后，他给她打了个电话，邀请她去纽约，算是证明她能做些什么。

sentences.en: And so she flies up there, grabs a hidden camera that was supplied to her by James O'Keefe, and she ends up meeting the daughter of Eric Garner.
sentences.zh: 于是她飞到那里，拿走了詹姆斯·奥基夫提供给她的隐藏摄像机，最终她见到了埃里克·加纳的女儿。

sentences.en: Eric Garner was this person who died in a chokehold from the New York City police.
sentences.zh: 埃里克·加纳就是那个死于纽约市警察扼喉之下的那个人。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And Loomer gets Eric Garner's daughter to make disparaging comments about Alice Sharpton, the prominent preacher and activist for the Black community.
sentences.zh: 卢默让埃里克·加纳的女儿对阿尔·夏普顿——这位黑人社区的知名牧师和活动家——发表了贬损性的评论。

sentences.en: Project Veritas loves this, shops it, and gets the New York Post to pick it up and puts it on the front page of the New York PoSt.
sentences.zh: “真理项目”非常喜欢这个，四处兜售，最终让《纽约邮报》采用并把它放到了《纽约邮报》的头版。

sentences.en: So Laura Loomer, college senior, not even graduated yet, has now gone completely viral.
sentences.zh: 所以劳拉·卢默，一个大四学生，甚至还没有毕业，现在就已经彻底火遍全网了。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, it does seem like this kind of knack, maybe even instinct for attention-seeking and viral moments.
sentences.zh: 对，我的意思是，她确实有一种天赋，甚至可以说是对博取关注和病毒式传播时刻的直觉。

sentences.en: She has it, you know, even in her college years.
sentences.zh: 她身上一直有这股劲，你知道的，甚至在大学时就是这样。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, she has a real gut for it.
sentences.zh: 没错，我是说，她对这方面有一种真正的直觉。

sentences.en: You know, she's studying broadcast journalism.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，她学的是广播新闻专业。

sentences.en: She imagines herself one day being sort of an on-air talent for Fox News or something.
sentences.zh: 她想象着自己有一天能成为福克斯新闻或类似机构的电视出镜人才。

sentences.en: But she really has a gut for the gotcha moment and for catching people on tape.
sentences.zh: 但她确实有一种捕捉“抓包”时刻和偷录别人谈话的敏锐直觉。

sentences.en: And when the opportunity strikes, she always seems to go for it.
sentences.zh: 每当机会来临，她似乎总是会毫不犹豫地抓住。

sentences.en: And it's around that same time, soon after she graduates from college, that Donald Trump
sentences.zh: 正是在那个时期，就在她大学毕业后不久，唐纳德·特朗普

sentences.en: goes down the golden escalator of the Trump Tower and announces his candidacy for president.
sentences.zh: 走下了特朗普大厦的金色自动扶梯，并宣布竞选总统。

sentences.en: And what does she tell you about that moment, about Trump's kind of entrance onto the political scene?
sentences.zh: 她对你讲述过那个时刻吗，关于特朗普初入政坛的那个时刻？

sentences.en: So as she tells it, she's in for Trump to be president from the beginning.
sentences.zh: 据她所说，她从一开始就全力支持特朗普当总统。

sentences.en: She's not interested in the other people who were running at the time, like Jeb Bush.
sentences.zh: 她对当时参选的其他候选人毫无兴趣，比如杰布·布什。

sentences.en: She said that she liked the way that he spoke, the way that he said what was on his mind.
sentences.zh: 她说她喜欢他说话的方式，喜欢他有什么说什么的风格。

sentences.en: And she says that she liked his values, what she would now call America first values, in a way that she didn't think the other candidates were.
sentences.zh: 她说她喜欢他的价值观——也就是她现在所说的“美国优先”价值观，这是她在其他候选人身上看不到的。

sentences.en: So Trump obviously wins in 2016.
sentences.zh: 所以特朗普在2016年毫无悬念地赢了。

sentences.en: What's her relationship to him then?
sentences.zh: 她当时和他的关系是怎么样的？

sentences.en: She doesn't have any kind of relationship with him at that period.
sentences.zh: 在那段时间里，她和他没有任何关系。

sentences.en: She doesn't know him at all.
sentences.zh: 她根本不认识他。

sentences.en: So instead, at that time, she's working hard on the kind of work she does, which is undercover journalism, catching people saying things on video they shouldn't say and blasting it
sentences.zh: 因此，在那时，她正全力以赴地从事她擅长的工作，也就是卧底新闻调查，捕捉人们在视频中不该说的话并将其

sentences.en: out as loud as possible.
sentences.zh: 大肆宣扬。

sentences.en: She's developing a huge following on social media.
sentences.zh: 她在社交媒体上正在积累大量的粉丝。

sentences.en: And less than two years out of college, she's now famous and also infamous at the same time
sentences.zh: 大学毕业还不到两年，她现在既是个名人，同时也恶名昭ุน，

sentences.en: because part and parcel of all this is being outrageous and saying things that most people won't say.
sentences.zh: 因为这一切的核心就是语不惊人死不休，说出大多数人不敢说的话。

sentences.en: One particular target of hers is Ilhan Omar, the Somali immigrant congresswoman from Minnesota.
sentences.zh: 她的一个特定攻击目标是伊尔han·奥马尔，这位来自明尼苏达州的索马里裔美国国会女议员。

sentences.en: Ilhan, why did you marry your brother?
sentences.zh: 伊尔han，你为什么嫁给了你哥哥？

sentences.en: Why did you commit immigration from it?
sentences.zh: 你为什么要进行移民欺诈？

sentences.en: You know, that's a crime here in the United States.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，在美国这是犯罪。

sentences.en: Why do you hate Jewish people so much?
sentences.zh: 你为什么那么痛恨犹太人？

sentences.en: She's been after her for years and has alleged that she married her own brother and violated immigration rules, none of which is true.
sentences.zh: 她纠缠对方多年，并指控她嫁给了自己的亲哥哥、违反了移民规定，这些全都是假的。

sentences.en: I would say her entire loyalty and her entire focus is to Islam.
sentences.zh: 我想说，她所有的忠诚和全部的关注点都在伊斯兰教上。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And that scene and the way that...
sentences.zh: 而那一幕以及那种方式……

sentences.en: She once, really, in a very ghoulish moment, celebrated the death of 2,000 Syrian migrants who drowned in the Mediterranean trying to flee the war there in 2017.
sentences.zh: 她曾在一场极其怪异的时刻，庆祝2017年在试图逃离当地战争时溺亡于地中海的2000名叙利亚难民的死亡。

sentences.en: Said that was great and there should be 2,000 more.
sentences.zh: 说这太棒了，还应该再死2000个。

sentences.en: Whoa.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: There's kind of no bottom to the pretty despicable, nasty things she's willing to say, at least in a public forum.
sentences.zh: 对于她愿意说出的那些极其卑鄙、恶毒的话，似乎毫无底线可言，至少在公开场合是这样的。

sentences.en: March against Sharia!
sentences.zh: 游行反对伊斯兰教法！

sentences.en: She has even called herself a hashtag proud Islamophobe.
sentences.zh: 她甚至自称是带标签的“骄傲的伊斯兰恐惧症患者”。

sentences.en: There's no question.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问。

sentences.en: We as an Islamic feminiSt.
sentences.zh: 我们作为伊斯兰女权主义者。

sentences.en: And that kind of stuff starts getting her into trouble.
sentences.zh: 诸如此类的事情开始给她惹上麻烦。

sentences.en: How do you get banned from Uber?
sentences.zh: 你怎么会被优步（Uber）封禁？

sentences.en: How do you get banned from Lyft?
sentences.zh: 你怎么会被来福车（Lyft）封禁？

sentences.en: How do you get banned from Uber Eats?
sentences.zh: 你怎么会被优步外卖（Uber Eats）封禁？

sentences.en: Just by being and existing as a conservative in this country.
sentences.zh: 就因为在这个国家作为一个保守派存在着。

sentences.en: She, in 2017, gets kicked off of Uber and Lyft because she made comments about them having
sentences.zh: 在2017年，她被优步和来福车踢出了平台，因为她发表了关于他们有

sentences.en: Islamic drivers and her not wanting to ride in a car with a Muslim.
sentences.zh: 伊斯兰教司机以及她不想搭乘穆斯林驾驶的汽车的言论。

sentences.en: And the following year, she gets kicked off Twitter because she has been abusive, particularly
sentences.zh: 第二年，她被推特（Twitter）封禁，因为她一直有辱骂行为，特别是

sentences.en: towards Ilhan Omar, the congresswoman, just going after her relentlessly on the platform.
sentences.zh: 针对国会议员伊尔han·奥马尔，在该平台上对她穷追猛打。

sentences.en: So she gets kicked off that site.
sentences.zh: 于是她被赶出了那个网站。

sentences.en: I have been defamed, okay?
sentences.zh: 我被诽谤了，好吗？

sentences.en: My life has been destroyed.
sentences.zh: 我的生活被毁了。

sentences.en: And pretty soon, it cascades and she's getting kicked off almost every social media platform.
sentences.zh: 很快，这种封杀呈雪崩效应，她几乎被赶出了每一个社交媒体平台。

sentences.en: I literally can't make a living anymore, even though I have a degree.
sentences.zh: 我字面意义上再也无法谋生了，尽管我有学位。

sentences.en: I was valedictorian.
sentences.zh: 我曾是毕业典礼的致词代表。

sentences.en: And that's an interesting thing because it becomes an effective muzzle to her in a lot of ways.
sentences.zh: 这是一件有趣的事，因为在很多方面，这成了对她的一次有效禁言。

sentences.en: Yeah, being deplatformed for this person, it does undermine her livelihood at this point, right?
sentences.zh: 对，被全网封禁对这个人来说，确实在此时动摇了她的生计，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, her professional success depends on her being able to spread her message.
sentences.zh: 我是说，她的职业成功取决于她能否传播自己的信息。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And if you read her book, which I have, you will hear in her words that this is one of the most scarring and painful events of her entire life.
sentences.zh: 如果你读过她的书，而我读过，你会从她的字里行间听到，这是她一生中最具创伤和最痛苦的事件之一。

sentences.en: Getting kicked off the platforms affects her in a way that I don't think it would affect most people.
sentences.zh: 被各大平台封杀对她的打击，我认为是大多数人无法感同身受的。

sentences.en: And she's desperate to find a way to get her voice back and trying to figure out some other way to be relevant now that she can't speak to millions of people on social media.
sentences.zh: 她迫切想要找到一种方法夺回话语权，既然无法在社交媒体上对数百万人发声，她便开始寻找其他保持相关度的方法。

sentences.en: So what does she do?
sentences.zh: 所以她做了什么？

sentences.en: So she runs for Congress, obviously.
sentences.zh: 所以很显然，她去竞选国会议员了。

sentences.en: Oh, clearly.
sentences.zh: 哦，显而易见。

sentences.en: In 2020, she runs for Congress, and though she wins the Republican primary, she loses in the general election.
sentences.zh: 在2020年，她竞选国会议员，尽管赢得了共和党党内初选，但在大选中落败。

sentences.en: And she runs again in 2022.
sentences.zh: 她在2022年再次参选。

sentences.en: And in that case, she loses in the primary.
sentences.zh: 而那一次，她在初选中就落败了。

sentences.en: So that second run fizzles out as well.
sentences.zh: 所以第二次竞选也无疾而终了。

sentences.en: You know, it strikes me that around that time, Trump had also been experiencing some of this.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我突然想到，大约在那时，特朗普也经历了一些类似的事情。

sentences.en: He had also just lost an election.
sentences.zh: 他也刚刚输掉了一场选举。

sentences.en: He was deplatformed from social media in the aftermath of January 6th.
sentences.zh: 在1月6日事件之后，他也被社交媒体平台封杀了。

sentences.en: Their trajectories are kind of aligning.
sentences.zh: 他们的轨迹在某种程度上开始重合了。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's a really good point.
sentences.zh: 对，这真是个精辟的观点。

sentences.en: She's off Twitter.
sentences.zh: 她被踢出推特了。

sentences.en: Now he's off Twitter.
sentences.zh: 现在他也离开推特了。

sentences.en: Her voice can't be heard, and his voice can't be heard in the same way.
sentences.zh: 她的声音无法被听到，而他的声音也无法以同样的方式被听到。

sentences.en: And they're suddenly sort of out in the wilderness, in a sense, together.
sentences.zh: 从某种意义上说，他们突然一起被放逐到了荒野之中。

sentences.en: And then for both of them, a life raft comes to them in the form of Elon Musk, of all people.
sentences.zh: 然后对他们两人来说，埃隆·马斯克——偏偏是这个人——给他们抛来了救生圈。

sentences.en: Elon Musk buys Twitter in the fall of 2022.
sentences.zh: 埃隆·马斯克在2022年秋天收购了推特。

sentences.en: And one of the very first things he does is reinstate Donald Trump's account, and also, importantly for this story, Laura Loomer's account.
sentences.zh: 他做的第一件事之一就是恢复了唐纳德·特朗普的账号，而且对这个故事至关重要的是，也恢复了劳拉·卢默的账号。

sentences.en: She gets reactivated in December 2022 and immediately pivots to her next big plan, which is to get Donald Trump re-elected and back in the White House.
sentences.zh: 她在2022年12月复出，并立即转向她的下一个重大计划，那就是让唐纳德·特朗普重新当选并重返白宫。

sentences.en: — And what does that look like, that plan, going all in on getting Trump re-elected?
sentences.zh: ——那么，这个全力以赴让特朗普重新当选的计划具体是怎样的？

sentences.en: — Well, it starts with focusing on the governor of Florida, Ron DeSantis.
sentences.zh: ——嗯，它始于将矛头对准佛罗里达州长罗恩·德桑蒂斯。

sentences.en: And while lots of people on the right were embracing DeSantis and excited about him,
sentences.zh: 当右翼的许多人都在拥护德桑蒂斯并对充满期待时，

sentences.en: Laura Loomer saw him as an obstacle and decided to focus essentially all of her energies on making it as hard for him as possible to win the Republican nomination.
sentences.zh: 劳拉·卢默却将他视为绊脚石，并决定将她几乎所有的精力都投入到一件事上：尽可能给他赢得共和党提名制造障碍。

sentences.en: And right into the beginning of 2023, before he's even declared that he's going to run for president, she stages a protest outside of a book-signing event that he's hosting
sentences.zh: 直到2023年初，甚至在他宣布竞选总统之前，她就在佛罗里达州一家书店举办的签售活动外组织了一场抗议。

sentences.en: at a bookstore in Florida.
sentences.zh: 一家佛罗里达的书店。

sentences.en: — We're simply supporting President Trump.
sentences.zh: ——我们只是在支持特朗普总统。

sentences.en: — She's wearing Trump gear, carrying Trump flags.
sentences.zh: ——她穿着特朗普的周边装备，挥舞着特朗普的旗帜。

sentences.en: And then, while the cameras are rolling, something happens.
sentences.zh: 然后，正当镜头在拍摄时，事情发生了。

sentences.en: — DeSantis people are in there saying, have me come out to tell you guys not to be here, why he's here.
sentences.zh: ——德桑蒂斯的人在里面说，让我出来告诉你们不要呆在这里，说明他为什么在这里。

sentences.en: — I thought that Governor DeSantis was, like, he always talks about how he's in favor of free speech.
sentences.zh: ——我以为德桑蒂斯州长一直都在说他是支持言论自由的。

sentences.en: Like, we have a First Amendment right to be here to rally in support of President Trump.
sentences.zh: 比如，我们有第一修正案赋予的权利来到这里集会支持特朗普总统。

sentences.en: — Security, hired by Ron DeSantis, goes out and tells her that she has to leave.
sentences.zh: ——由罗恩·德桑蒂斯雇佣的安保人员走出来，告诉她必须离开。

sentences.en: — I need you guys to leave, please.
sentences.zh: ——我需要你们离开，拜托。

sentences.en: — Okay?
sentences.zh: ——好吗？

sentences.en: — We don't want DeSantis to run for president.
sentences.zh: ——我们不希望德桑蒂斯竞选总统。

sentences.en: — Okay, that's fine.
sentences.zh: ——好吧，没关系。

sentences.en: — And that turns out to be a viral moment.
sentences.zh: ——事实证明，这是一个病毒式传播的时刻。

sentences.en: Laura Loomer puts that out everywhere.
sentences.zh: 劳拉·卢默把这段视频发得到处都是。

sentences.en: — Yeah, I mean, what a bad political move by the DeSantis camp, right?
sentences.zh: ——对，我是说，德桑蒂斯阵营这是多么糟糕的政治昏招，对吧？

sentences.en: Like, that just plays right into Laura Loomer's hands.
sentences.zh: 这简直是直接正中劳拉·卢默的下怀。

sentences.en: This is her playbook, and he's just following it, basically.
sentences.zh: 这就是她的惯用套路，而他基本上就是按着她的剧本走。

sentences.en: — I mean, total red meat for Laura Loomer.
sentences.zh: ——我的意思是，这对劳拉·卢默来说绝对是绝佳的大补之物。

sentences.en: She jumps on it, makes a slice of bologna into a giant ham sandwich, and goes crazy with it.
sentences.zh: 她抓住机会，把一片博洛尼亚香肠吹嘘成一个巨大的火腿三明治，并借此大做文章。

sentences.en: And she also catches the attention of the one person she's most interested in seeing this, which is Donald Trump himself.
sentences.zh: 她还成功吸引了她最希望看到这一切的人的注意，那就是唐纳德·特朗普本人。

sentences.en: — She loves to tell the story that her phone rings, and it's an unlisted number.
sentences.zh: ——她非常喜欢讲述那个故事：她的手机响了，显示是一个未知号码。

sentences.en: — I answer it, and it's like, hello?
sentences.zh: ——我接起电话，那边说，喂？

sentences.en: I was like, who's this?
sentences.zh: 我当时想，这是谁啊？

sentences.en: Right, I was very annoyed.
sentences.zh: 没错，我当时非常恼火。

sentences.en: It's like, hello, Laura, it's your favorite president, Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 对方说，喂，劳拉，我是你最喜欢的总统，唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: And I thought it was a prank call.
sentences.zh: 我以为这是一个恶作剧电话。

sentences.en: — It's on point.
sentences.zh: ——这太经典了。

sentences.en: — And I was like, no, really, honestly, who is this?
sentences.zh: ——我当时说，不，说真的，老实告诉我，你到底是谁？

sentences.en: Don't waste my time.
sentences.zh: 别浪费我的时间。

sentences.en: — And she doesn't believe it's him at first, but it is.
sentences.zh: ——她起初不相信那是他，但确实是他。

sentences.en: And he convinces her that it's Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 而且他成功说服了她，证明自己就是唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: — I just love what you did today that was sanctimonious.
sentences.zh: ——我太喜欢你今天对那个伪君子做的事了。

sentences.en: And it was really, honestly, President Trump.
sentences.zh: 说真的，老实说，那就是特朗普总统。

sentences.en: And I just couldn't believe it.
sentences.zh: 我简直不敢相信。

sentences.en: And we had a phone call for, like, 15 minutes, and he was telling me how much he loved me, and he thought it was amazing.
sentences.zh: 我们通了大约15分钟的电话，他一直在告诉我他有多喜欢我，他觉得这太惊艳了。

sentences.en: And he was just like, oh, no.
sentences.zh: 他当时就说，哦，天哪。

sentences.en: — And she cannot believe this is happening to her.
sentences.zh: ——而她简直不敢相信这种事会发生在她身上。

sentences.en: This is the culmination of all this work and dreaming she's had that Donald Trump is calling her.
sentences.zh: 这是她所有的努力和梦想的顶峰，唐纳德·特朗普竟然亲自给她打电话了。

sentences.en: And to make it even better, he says to her he wants her to come to Mar-a-Lago and meet him in person.
sentences.zh: 更棒的是，他对她说，他希望她去海湖庄园当面见他。

sentences.en: — Wow.
— And that is major, huge for Laura Loomer.
sentences.zh: ——对劳拉·卢默来说，这绝对是一件大事、天大的事。

sentences.en: — And she could not be more excited.
sentences.zh: ——她兴奋得无以复加。

sentences.en: She gets her nails done.
sentences.zh: 她去做了指甲。

sentences.en: She gets her hairs done.
sentences.zh: 她做了头发。

sentences.en: She buys a new outfit.
sentences.zh: 她买了一套新衣服。

sentences.en: And she goes to Mar-a-Lago and is ushered into his office.
sentences.zh: 然后她前往海湖庄园，被领进了他的办公室。

sentences.en: And there he is with Susie Wiles, who was going to be running his campaign.
sentences.zh: 苏西·怀尔斯也在那里，她将负责管理他的竞选团队。

sentences.en: — And I was so nervous.
sentences.zh: ——我当时紧张极了。

sentences.en: I sat in his office, and we started talking, and it was just supposed to be, like, a thank you.
sentences.zh: 我坐在他的办公室里，我们开始交谈，这本来应该只是一场表达感谢的会面。

sentences.en: You know, like, oh, Laura Loomer is your biggest fan.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，就像是，哦，劳拉·卢默是你最大的粉丝。

sentences.en: You can meet her.
sentences.zh: 你可以见见她。

sentences.en: And I gave him a signed copy of my book, and I said, Mr. President, you're my hero.
sentences.zh: 我送了他一本我签过名的书，我说，总统先生，你是我的英雄。

sentences.en: — So they're there together in Mar-a-Lago, and Trump asks her what she's seen in the political space.
sentences.zh: ——所以他们一起在海湖庄园，特朗普问她对政坛有什么看法。

sentences.en: — And she launches into lots of attacks on lots of Republicans that she says aren't really loyal to the MAGA movement,
sentences.zh: ——于是她开始猛烈抨击许多她认为对MAGA运动不够忠诚的共和党人，

sentences.en: that aren't loyal to Trump, that she thinks are not worthy of his attentions.
sentences.zh: 认为他们对特朗普不忠，觉得他们不配得到他的关注。

sentences.en: — And he's just staring at me.
sentences.zh: ——而他就那样盯着我。

sentences.en: He goes, wow.
sentences.zh: 他说，哇。

sentences.en: He's like, you really know what you're talking about.
sentences.zh: 他说，你真的很懂这些。

sentences.en: — She's making a huge impression on Trump.
sentences.zh: ——她在特朗普心中留下了极其深刻的印象。

sentences.en: You know, this is her opportunity, and she's not going to squander it.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这是她的机会，她绝不会把它白白挥霍掉。

sentences.en: And it clearly works, because towards the end of the meeting, Trump tells her she should run for Congress again.
sentences.zh: 这显然奏效了，因为在会面快结束时，特朗普告诉她应该再次竞选国会议员。

sentences.en: — So he said, Susie, let's find a district for her.
sentences.zh: ——所以他说，苏西，我们给她找个选区吧。

sentences.en: And I just looked at the president, and I said, you know, Mr. President, I don't want to run for Congress.
sentences.zh: 我看着总统，然后我说，你知道的，总统先生，我不想竞选国会议员。

sentences.en: I want you to win.
sentences.zh: 我希望你能赢。

sentences.en: I said, there's no point in anyone being in Congress if you're not the president.
sentences.zh: 我说，如果你不是总统，任何人进国会都没有意义。

sentences.en: And so he loved what I said.
sentences.zh: 所以他很喜欢我说的话。

sentences.en: I said, I want to put you firSt.
sentences.zh: 我说，我想把你放在第一位。

sentences.en: — And she says, I don't want to run for Congress.
sentences.zh: — 而她说，我不想竞选国会议员。

sentences.en: The only thing I want to do is to make sure you get elected.
sentences.zh: 我唯一想做的事，就是确保你当选。

sentences.en: — Well, of course, that kind of public, open show of loyalty is exactly what Trump wants to hear, and he loves it.
sentences.zh: — 呃，当然，这种公开、坦荡的忠诚表态正是特朗普想听到的，他非常喜欢。

sentences.en: And it has a big smile on his face and says, Susie, we should hire this woman.
sentences.zh: 他脸上带着灿烂的笑容说，苏茜，我们应该录用这位女士。

sentences.en: — Susie said that she was going to get me set up with paperwork and whatever.
sentences.zh: — 苏茜说她会帮我弄好文书工作之类的事情。

sentences.en: And she wanted me to come down to the campaign headquarter office to meet with her.
sentences.zh: 她想让我去竞选总部办公室和她见面。

sentences.en: — And so this begins the application process for a job within the Trump campaign.
sentences.zh: — 于是，这就拉开了申请特朗普竞选团队职位的序幕。

sentences.en: And Loomer is expecting to start, I think, on April 1st or somewhere around that, 2023 for the campaign.
sentences.zh: 我认为，卢默原本期待在2023年4月1日前后开始为竞选团队工作。

sentences.en: She submits her tax forMs.
sentences.zh: 她提交了税务表格。

sentences.en: She does all the things you need to begin that job.
sentences.zh: 她完成了开始这份工作所需的一切手续。

sentences.en: And she's thinking she's going to be probably working on comms, communications for the campaign.
sentences.zh: 她以为自己大概会从事竞选团队的公关和传播工作。

sentences.en: — And that her political career and her dream of working for Donald Trump is about to take off.
sentences.zh: — 而她的政治生涯以及为唐纳德·特朗普工作的梦想即将腾飞。

sentences.en: — And what happens?
sentences.zh: — 结果呢？

sentences.en: — The job never materializes.
sentences.zh: — 这份工作根本没有落实。

sentences.en: It never happens.
sentences.zh: 它从未发生过。

sentences.en: She learns, in fact, from a story in this newspaper that after discussions inside the campaign about hiring her, there's been a decision not to hire her.
sentences.zh: 事实上，她从这家报纸的一篇报道中得知，在竞选团队内部讨论是否录用她之后，最终作出了不录用的决定。

sentences.en: — And nobody called me.
sentences.zh: — 而且没有人打电话给我。

sentences.en: I never got a phone call from anybody on the campaign telling me after that, by the way, you know, we're really sorry about this.
sentences.zh: 竞选团队里没有任何人给打过电话告诉我，顺便说一句，你知道的，我们对此感到非常抱歉。

sentences.en: I never got a phone call saying hey.
sentences.zh: 我从来没有接到过任何电话。

sentences.en: — She is absolutely devastated.
sentences.zh: — 她彻底崩溃了。

sentences.en: — Well, like I said, it's always been about Trump for me.
sentences.zh: — 嗯，就像我说的，对我而言一切总是围绕着特朗普。

sentences.en: So I was upset.
sentences.zh: 所以我很难过。

sentences.en: I was so depressed.
sentences.zh: 我太沮丧了。

sentences.en: I cried so much.
sentences.zh: 我哭了很久。

sentences.en: — And do we know why?
sentences.zh: — 那我们知道原因吗？

sentences.en: — Well, we have reporting that people inside the campaign were quite worried about hiring Laura Loomer and didn't think it would be an asset to the campaign to have her there.
sentences.zh: — 嗯，据我们报道，竞选团队内部的人非常担心录用劳拉·卢默，认为让她加入并不会给竞选带来优势。

sentences.en: — Fears that she was too loose of a cannon, that she was too hard to manage, and that she could be a liability to the campaign.
sentences.zh: — 人们担心她是个口无遮拦的自由派，太难管理，而且可能会成为竞选团队的负资产。

sentences.en: And even though Donald Trump had asked for it, there was just such strong pressure not to that those in power beneath Trump made sure it didn't occur.
sentences.zh: 尽管唐纳德·特朗普曾提出要求，但由于反对的呼声实在太强，特朗普手下的当权者确保了这件事没有发生。

sentences.en: And if you follow her social media or you talk to her, she brings this up more than almost any other topic.
sentences.zh: 如果你关注她的社交媒体或与她交谈，你会发现她提起这件事的频率几乎超过了其他任何话题。

sentences.en: This almost getting hired and then not getting hired is another foundational moment in her life and one she's very upset up.
sentences.zh: 这次差点被录用随后又被拒绝，是她人生中的另一个奠基时刻，也让她感到非常愤怒。

sentences.en: And so she takes the feelings of this rejection and channels them through her grievance into a new and arguably more important mission to rid his campaign and his administration of anyone she considers an enemy.
sentences.zh: 因此，她将这种被拒绝的情绪通过满腹牢骚转化成了一项新的、可以说是更重要的使命：将她视为敌人的任何人从他的竞选团队和政府中清除出去。

sentences.en: — There's something about rejection that motivates you to become even more efficient.
sentences.zh: — 被拒绝的经历往往能激发出让你变得更高效的动力。

sentences.en: — We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: — 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: — I'm Winnalou.
sentences.zh: — 我是温娜露。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》游戏板块字谜游戏“连接”的创作者。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢尝试捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖斯基，我每天创作游戏“拼字蜂”和“字母箱”。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做色彩联觉的病症。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 当我听音乐时我能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像刚刚你听到声音的人这样的一群人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com 加上 games 开始今天的游戏。

sentences.en: So tell me about this new mission that Loomer pours herself into after she's turned away by Team Trump.
sentences.zh: 那么，跟我讲讲在被特朗普团队拒之门外后，卢默全身心投入的新使命吧。

sentences.en: — So the thing that Loomer starts to think about is that the enemies are everywhere.
sentences.zh: — 那么，卢默开始意识到，敌人无处不在。

sentences.en: And that the campaign and the incoming administration and the entire Republican Party is riddled with people who are not sufficiently loyal to Trump.
sentences.zh: 竞选团队、即将上台的政府以及整个共和党都充斥着对特朗普不够忠诚的人。

sentences.en: And so her project develops as what she calls vetting.
sentences.zh: 因此，她的项目逐渐发展成了她所谓的“审查”。

sentences.en: Or sometimes she calls it extreme vetting, which is finding people who don't love Trump the way she does, who don't love MAGA the way she does, and to publicly out them.
sentences.zh: 或者有时她称之为“极端审查”，也就是找出那些不像她那样热爱特朗普、不像她那样热爱“让美国再次伟大（MAGA）”的人，并公开曝光他们。

sentences.en: And hopefully, she frequently says, to end their careers.
sentences.zh: 正如她经常说的那样，希望以此终结他们的职业生涯。

sentences.en: — I really enjoy and I take great pleasure in humiliating people who suck at their job.
sentences.zh: — 我真的很享受，并且从羞辱那些工作能力极差的人中获得极大的快感。

sentences.en: I do.
sentences.zh: 真的。

sentences.en: Especially when people steal opportunities from me.
sentences.zh: 特别是当有人抢走属于我的机会时。

sentences.en: I really like rubbing it in their face by showing them that I can do a job way better than they can.
sentences.zh: 我真的很喜欢通过向他们证明我能把工作做得比他们好得多，来狠狠地羞辱他们。

sentences.en: — So she walked me through her process, actually, in a conversation we had about this.
sentences.zh: — 事实上，在一次关于这个话题的交谈中，她向我详细解释了她的整个流程。

sentences.en: She looks for names for people on the list of people who are being appointed or nominated or considered for nomination or in the party or have jobs in PACs and fundraising committees and things like that.
sentences.zh: 她在被任命、被提名、考虑提名、党内、政治行动委员会（PAC）以及筹款委员会等地任职的人员名单中寻找名字。

sentences.en: And then she begins to pick them apart.
sentences.zh: 然后她开始对他们进行剥茧抽丝般的调查。

sentences.en: — If there's, like, a judge that rules against Trump, I start looking into the judge.
sentences.zh: — 如果有某个法官做出对特朗普不利的裁决，我就会开始调查这个法官。

sentences.en: — You Google his name.
sentences.zh: — 你会谷歌他的名字。

sentences.en: — I Google his name.
sentences.zh: — 我会谷歌他的名字。

sentences.en: And then I start looking up their LinkedIn, their resume, like, looking up, you know, their mortgage.
sentences.zh: 然后我开始查他们的领英、简历，比如，查他们的房贷。

sentences.en: — That's your normal process.
sentences.zh: — 这就是你的常规流程。

sentences.en: — And look for anything she can find on the internet, on public filings, on campaign contributions,
sentences.zh: — 并在互联网、公开备案、竞选捐款中寻找她能找到的一切。

sentences.en: anything she can find that suggests to her that they might not be 100% in line with what her vision of MAGA is.
sentences.zh: 任何能让她发现这些人可能与她对 MAGA 的愿景并非百分之百一致的蛛丝马迹。

sentences.en: — I mean, I go through finances, I go through, like, marital relationships, spouses, kids.
sentences.zh: — 我的意思是，我会查财务状况，查婚姻关系、配偶、孩子。

sentences.en: — She told me that if she can't find anything in the first pass, then she looks at their spouse.
sentences.zh: — 她告诉我，如果在第一轮中找不到任何东西，她就会调查他们的配偶。

sentences.en: And if she can't find anything in the spouse, she looks at their children.
sentences.zh: 如果在配偶身上找不到，她就查他们的孩子。

sentences.en: And if she can't find anything in their children, she looks for their siblings.
sentences.zh: 如果在孩子身上找不到，她就查他们的兄弟姐妹。

sentences.en: — She can't find anything in their siblings.
sentences.zh: — 如果在兄弟姐妹身上找不到。

sentences.en: She looks for their parents.
sentences.zh: 她就会查他们的父母。

sentences.en: She looks for any link in the family that might not be sufficiently MAGA for her criteria.
sentences.zh: 她会寻找家庭中任何不符合她 MAGA 标准的链条。

sentences.en: And she weaponizes that.
sentences.zh: 并以此作为武器。

sentences.en: — It just happens to be the case that there's always a conflict, like, especially with the spouses.
sentences.zh: — 碰巧的是，总会有利益冲突，特别是在配偶方面。

sentences.en: It gets every time.
sentences.zh: 每次都能查出问题。

sentences.en: — And so if she finds out that someone's uncle, you know, was a Democratic councilman from some city or their grandfather owned a business in another country,
sentences.zh: — 所以，如果她发现某人的叔叔曾经是某个城市的民主党议员，或者他们的祖父在另一个国家拥有企业，

sentences.en: she will bring that forward as evidence that that person shouldn't be there, is dangerous, and is a threat to the administration.
sentences.zh: 她就会把这些作为证据，证明这个人不应该在那里，此人很危险，是政府的威胁。

sentences.en: — Can you just give me some examples of her targets?
sentences.zh: — 你能举几个她目标的例子吗？

sentences.en: — Yeah, well, perhaps one of the most prominent ones is a group of people who worked for the National Security Council,
sentences.zh: — 嗯，最突出的目标之一或许是一群曾在国家安全委员会工作的人，

sentences.en: who she en masse tried to get fired in early April and was fairly successful.
sentences.zh: 她在4月初试图集体让他们被解雇，并且取得了相当大的成功。

sentences.en: — You know, I was doing all my own vetting at this time, and then SignalGate happened, like, right off.
sentences.zh: — 你知道的，当时我正在做我自己的审查，然后“信号门”事件就发生了，几乎紧随其后。

sentences.en: — She got interested in these people because of what we now call SignalGate, which was this incident in which Mike Waltz, the national security advisor,
sentences.zh: — 她对这些人产生兴趣是因为我们现在所称的“信号门”事件，当时国家安全顾问迈克·沃尔茨

sentences.en: created a group chat with all kinds of people in it to discuss plans to attack Houthi rebels in Yemen.
sentences.zh: 建立了一个包含各种人员的群聊，用来讨论攻击也门胡塞武装的计划。

sentences.en: And accidentally, a journalist was admitted in the chat who got to observe this happening.
sentences.zh: 不小心的是，一名记者被拉进了群聊，从而得以观察到这一切的发生。

sentences.en: — And Laura Loomer noticed that one of the people in the chat was a guy named Alex Wong, who was a deputy to Mike Waltz, the national security advisor.
sentences.zh: — 劳拉·卢默注意到群聊中的其中一个人名叫亚历克斯·王，他是国家安全顾问迈克·沃尔茨的副手。

sentences.en: — And I started doing my own deep dive on Alex Wong and his wife.
sentences.zh: — 于是我开始对亚历克斯·王和他的妻子进行深入调查。

sentences.en: — And she discovered that he worked on the 2012 campaign of Mitt Romney, the Republican nominee for president and a fierce critic of Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: — 她发现他曾为2012年总统候选人、共和党人、同时也是唐纳德·特朗普的激烈批评者米特·罗姆尼的竞选团队工作过。

sentences.en: Then she discovered that Wong's wife worked in the Justice Department under Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 然后她发现沃王的妻子曾在乔·拜登领导下的司法部工作。

sentences.en: — Because I said, wait, so how does somebody become the deputy national security advisor and their wife was involved in prosecuting J-6ers?
sentences.zh: — 因为我说，等等，怎么会有人能当上副国家安全顾问，而他的妻子却参与起诉了“1·6事件”的参与者？

sentences.en: It was very shocking stuff.
sentences.zh: 这真是令人震惊的内容。

sentences.en: — That was, to her mind, a red flag, even though, of course, the woman worked previously in the first Trump Justice Department.
sentences.zh: — 在她看来，这是一个危险信号，尽管当然，这位女士此前曾在第一届特朗普政府的司法部工作过。

sentences.en: So she starts going on X like crazy and saying that Alex Wong is unfit for office,
sentences.zh: 于是她开始疯狂刷X平台，称亚历克斯·王不适合公职，

sentences.en: shouldn't have a job, he's a threat, he might even be deep state or some kind of subversive element.
sentences.zh: 不配拥有工作，他是一个威胁，甚至可能是深层政府或某种颠覆分子。

sentences.en: — And then...
sentences.zh: — 然后……

sentences.en: — I got a phone call from the White House, and it was President Trump.
sentences.zh: — 我接到了白宫打来的电话，来电者是特朗普总统。

sentences.en: — Donald Trump gets wind of this.
sentences.zh: — 唐纳德·特朗普听到了风声。

sentences.en: — And he goes, wow, so I have your report here on Wong, and tell me about this report.
sentences.zh: — 他说，哇，我这里有你关于王的报告，跟我讲讲这份报告吧。

sentences.en: And he's asking me about my report, and I'm telling him.
sentences.zh: 他在向我询问我的报告，而我正在向他介绍。

sentences.en: And he said, oh, I want you to come to the White House, and I want you to let me know who else is problematic.
sentences.zh: 他说，哦，我想让你来白宫，我想让你告诉我还有谁有问题。

sentences.en: I mean, those aren't the exact words that he used, right?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这些并不是他用的原话，对吧？

sentences.en: But that was the sentiment, right?
sentences.zh: 但那就是他的意思，对吧？

sentences.en: — And invites her to come to the White House.
sentences.zh: — 并邀请她去白宫。

sentences.en: It's her first-ever Oval Office visit, first-ever White House visit.
sentences.zh: 这是她有生以来第一次参观椭圆形办公室，也是第一次访问白宫。

sentences.en: And she walks in with a sheaf of papers about 12 different people that she thinks should be fired, including Alex Wong.
sentences.zh: 她手里拿着厚厚一叠文件，里面提到了大约12个她认为应该被解雇的人，其中包括亚历克斯·王。

sentences.en: — And what does Trump do?
sentences.zh: — 那特朗普做了什么？

sentences.en: What does he say?
sentences.zh: 他说什么了？

sentences.en: — So he listens to this presentation, and it's a pretty incredible scene.
sentences.zh: — 所以他听取了这次汇报，这是一个相当不可思议的场景。

sentences.en: — I brought my list and presented it, and then Michael Waltz was freaking out when he found out I was there, and he stormed into the Oval Office while I was there.
sentences.zh: — 我带了我的名单并进行了汇报，然后迈克尔·沃尔茨发现我在那儿时气急败坏，在我还在的时候就冲进了椭圆形办公室。

sentences.en: — And in the middle of this conversation, Mike Waltz himself walks into the office and has to listen to Laura Loomer besmirch him and the people who work for him.
sentences.zh: — 在这次谈话进行到一半时，迈克·沃尔茨本人走进了办公室，不得不听着劳拉·卢默诋毁他以及他的手下。

sentences.en: And according to various accounts, including Laura Loomer's but others as well—
sentences.zh: 根据各种说法，包括劳拉·卢默自己的说法以及其他人的说法——

sentences.en: — Trump ends the meeting by saying, we have to get rid of these people, we have to fire these people.
sentences.zh: — 特朗普在会议结束时说，我们必须除掉这些人，我们必须解雇这些人。

sentences.en: And indeed, within hours, Trump has fired six of the 12 people that she put on a list in front of him.
sentences.zh: 果不其然，在几个小时内，特朗普就解雇了她摆在他面前名单上的12个人中的6个。

sentences.en: — Wow.
So basically, Trump sides with Loomer over Waltz, his own national security advisor.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上，在卢默和他的国家安全顾问沃尔茨之间，特朗普站在了卢默一边。

sentences.en: — Yeah, that's right.
sentences.zh: — 是的，没错。

sentences.en: And it's worth noting that Wong never did lose his job, but Mike Waltz did.
sentences.zh: 值得一提的是，王最终确实没有丢掉工作，但迈克·沃尔茨丢了。

sentences.en: He was pushed out of the national security advisor job and sent over to be the ambassador to the United Nations.
sentences.zh: 他被挤出了国家安全顾问的职位，被派去担任联合国大使。

sentences.en: — Okay, that's her first big success, and I do remember it.
sentences.zh: — 好的，那是她的第一个巨大成功，我也确实记得这件事。

sentences.en: It made a lot of waves.
sentences.zh: 它引发了轩然大波。

sentences.en: What else does she do?
sentences.zh: 她还做了什么？

sentences.en: How does this progress?
sentences.zh: 这事是怎么发展的？

sentences.en: — Well, she realizes she's hit on something big, and she goes on what could more or less be thought of as a rampage,
sentences.zh: — 嗯，她意识到自己抓住了某种重大机遇，于是展开了可以说是一场狂欢式的行动，

sentences.en: trying everything she can to get more people fired and finding success doing it.
sentences.zh: 千方百计地想要让更多的人被解雇，并且不断取得成功。

sentences.en: She calls them scalps, and she's racking up one after the other throughout the spring and into the summer.
sentences.zh: 她称这些为战利品，整个春天直到夏天，她一个接一个地斩获战果。

sentences.en: — Michael Waltz, General Hogg, also Hunter Biden.
sentences.zh: — 迈克尔·沃尔茨、霍格将军，还有亨特·拜登。

sentences.en: Like, I got his Secret Service detail completely revoked, so that was great.
sentences.zh: 比如，我让他的特勤局安保人员被彻底撤职了，所以那感觉太棒了。

sentences.en: — She gets Hunter Biden's Secret Service detail taken away from him.
sentences.zh: — 她剥夺了亨特·拜登的特勤局安保待遇。

sentences.en: — Yeah, the Surgeon General, Jeanette Nishwat, so that's great, too.
sentences.zh: — 对，还有外科医生总长珍妮特·内什瓦特，所以这也挺棒的。

sentences.en: — She gets people who are going to be nominated to be important jobs, like the Surgeon General gets their nomination pulled.
sentences.zh: — 她让那些本将被提名担任重要职务的人，比如外科医生总长，提名被撤回。

sentences.en: She gets an assistant U.S.
sentences.zh: 她让美国加利福尼亚中区助理联邦

sentences.en: attorney in Los Angeles fired.
sentences.zh: 检察官被解雇。

sentences.en: — Like, some of the betting I do, while all of it is always intended to support the president,
sentences.zh: — 就像我做的一些审查一样，虽然其初衷始终是为了支持总统，

sentences.en: I do go out of my way a lot of the time to highlight very specific cases of actual incompetence
sentences.zh: 但很多时候我确实会特意挑出那些真正无能的具体案例来进行曝光，

sentences.en: when I know people don't have those jobs because they deserve those jobs and they're not doing a good job.
sentences.zh: 因为我知道这些人占据职位并非因为他们胜任这份工作，而且他们工作做得很糟糕。

sentences.en: — And it's an incredible run, and one that sends terror throughout the entire Republican Party.
sentences.zh: — 这是一次令人难以置信的战绩，并在整个共和党内部引发了恐慌。

sentences.en: — And just to gut check us for a minute, obviously it's in Loomer's interest to claim what she calls scalps, but how can we be sure that she's behind it?
sentences.zh: — 为了让我们冷静核实一下，显而易见，宣称获得所谓战利品对卢默有利，但我们怎么能确信幕后黑手确实是她呢？

sentences.en: — It's a good question.
sentences.zh: — 这是一个好问题。

sentences.en: The administration has generally stopped short of saying Laura Loomer got this person fired.
sentences.zh: 政府总体上避免明说“劳拉·卢默搞砸了这个人”。

sentences.en: They haven't disabused people of the idea either, but she's claimed it, and certainly the fact that she is going there in person saying this stuff
sentences.zh: 他们也没有消除公众的这种想法，但她自己宣称了这一点，而且毫无疑问的是，她亲自去到那里说这些话

sentences.en: and seeing results almost instantly is a very strong indication that if she's not the only factor, she's a big factor.
sentences.zh: 并且几乎立刻就能看到结果，这强烈表明，即使她不是唯一的因素，也是一个巨大因素。

sentences.en: We've seen several instances where she, out of the blue, has posted about someone being nominated for a job or in a job that she thinks they shouldn't have,
sentences.zh: 我们已经见过好几次这样的情况：她无缘无故地发帖谈论某人被提名或正担任她认为不该担任的职位，

sentences.en: and within 12 hours or even less sometimes, that person is gone.
sentences.zh: 然后在12小时内甚至有时更短的时间里，那个人就下台了。

sentences.en: And she discovers pretty quickly that she can weigh in not just on who gets hired or fired, but what the government decides to do.
sentences.zh: 她很快发现，她不仅可以对谁被录用或解雇发表意见，还可以对政府决定做什么施加影响。

sentences.en: And one of the things she starts getting into is policy.
sentences.zh: 她开始涉足的领域之一就是政策。

sentences.en: And one example of that happened recently, she learned that a charity was bringing in children from Gaza who had been injured in the conflict there
sentences.zh: 其中一个例子最近发生了，她得知一个慈善机构正在将加沙冲突中受伤的儿童

sentences.en: and was bringing them to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 带到美国来接受重要且往往能改变命运的外科手术。

sentences.en: for important, often life-changing surgeries.
sentences.zh: 这些通常是炸断了双腿和双臂的孩子。

sentences.en: These are often kids who had legs blown off and arms blown off.
sentences.zh: 这些通常是炸断了双腿和双臂的孩子。

sentences.en: Some of them were emaciated.
sentences.zh: 其中一些人已经骨瘦如柴。

sentences.en: And Loomer went online and said that this was importing terrorists and it must stop.
sentences.zh: 而鲁默在网上发文称，这是在输入恐怖分子，必须制止。

sentences.en: And after a day of posting about this online, she picked up the phone and called Marco Rubio, the Secretary of State, and told him that he needed to pay attention to this.
sentences.zh: 在网上发帖一天后，她拿起电话打给国务卿马可·鲁比奥，告诉他必须重视此事。

sentences.en: Well, the next morning, Marco Rubio announced that he was pausing all visas from Palestine
sentences.zh: 结果第二天早晨，马可·鲁比奥就宣布暂停发放所有巴勒斯坦签证

sentences.en: Palestine for further review and was checking for ties to terrorist organizations for this charity.
sentences.zh: 暂停巴勒斯坦签证以便进一步审查，并为该慈善机构核查其与恐怖组织的关联。

sentences.en: I mean, it's just remarkable when you think of how many foreign leaders in this world would love to be able to pick up the phone and get Marco Rubio's ear right now.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，当你想到世界上有多少外国领导人现在多么希望能拿起电话直接跟马可·鲁比奥对话时，这真让人感慨。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's truly, it's incredible.
sentences.zh: 对，这确实令人难以置信。

sentences.en: I mean, the access she has is amazing.
sentences.zh: 我是说，她能接触到的人物和渠道真是惊人。

sentences.en: And I think it's an interesting thing to contrast with the fact that if you ask her,
sentences.zh: 而且我觉得，这与一个事实形成了有趣的对比：如果你去问她，

sentences.en: she still thinks that she doesn't have the access she deserves and still is fostered by resentment
sentences.zh: 她依然认为自己没有得到应有的重视，心中依然充满了怨气，

sentences.en: because she didn't get invited to go to the summit in Alaska the way that another right-wing influencer did.
sentences.zh: 因为她没有像另一个右翼网红那样被邀请去参加阿拉斯加峰会。

sentences.en: I was texting with her recently and she complained that it's so unfair and no one respects her.
sentences.zh: 我最近跟她发短信时，她抱怨说这太不公平了，根本没人尊重她。

sentences.en: It's really hard to get rid of a chip on your shoulder.
sentences.zh: 心里的不平衡感和受害者心态真的是很难消除。

sentences.en: I have to ask, we know Trump is loving it.
sentences.zh: 我得问问，我们知道特朗普对此乐见其头。

sentences.en: How's the rest of Washington reacting to her outsized role?
sentences.zh: 华盛顿的其他对此有什么反应，看待她这种超乎寻常的角色？

sentences.en: I think the word you would probably associate with how most Republicans feel when they see Laura Loomer is abject terror.
sentences.zh: 我想大多数共和党人看到劳拉·鲁默时的感受，大概可以用“绝对的恐惧”来形容。

sentences.en: When I spent time with her in the halls of Congress on Capitol Hill, whenever a Republican congressman would see Loomer, their eyes would get big
sentences.zh: 当我和她在国会山的大厅里同行时，每当有共和党议员看到鲁默，他们的眼睛就会睁得老大，

sentences.en: and it looked like they were trying to battle with their fight or flight reflexes.
sentences.zh: 看起来就像是在竭力克制自己应激反应中的“战斗或逃跑”本能。

sentences.en: They didn't know whether to get away from her or to come up to her.
sentences.zh: 他们不知道该赶紧走开，还是主动迎上去。

sentences.en: And ultimately, what most of them choose to do is go up to her in a very guarded and careful way.
sentences.zh: 最终，他们大多数人选择的都是以一种极其戒备和小心翼翼的方式走过去打招呼。

sentences.en: And I think their fear of her is quite palpable and, frankly, understandable given the influence she has.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为他们对她的恐惧是显而易见的，坦白说，考虑到她所拥有的影响力，这也是可以理解的。

sentences.en: You know, we've seen the Trump administration empower many influencers, not just Laura Loomer.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们看到特朗普政府赋予了许多网红权力，不只是劳拉·鲁默。

sentences.en: People in nontraditional media, you know, bringing those folks into the White House press briefing room.
sentences.zh: 来自非传统媒体的人，你知道的，把这些人请进了白宫新闻发布厅。

sentences.en: They've kind of fed that beast in many ways.
sentences.zh: 他们在很多方面都在纵容这种力量。

sentences.en: And it's worked well for them a lot of the time.
sentences.zh: 而且很多时候，这招对他们挺管用的。

sentences.en: But there have been these moments at which those influencers have kind of turned against them.
sentences.zh: 但也有过这样的时刻，那些网红反过来对付他们。

sentences.en: Epstein being the starkest, most recent example of that.
sentences.zh: 爱泼斯坦事件就是其中最鲜明、最近期的例子。

sentences.en: And I wonder whether you think there's a world where embracing people like Loomer, who are willing to cross all of these lines, might come back to bite the White House.
sentences.zh: 我在想，你是否认为会有这样一种可能：接纳像鲁默这样愿意打破所有常规底线的人，最终可能会反噬白宫？

sentences.en: There are a lot of people in the administration who think of her as a ticking time bomb, as something that is extremely dangerous and should be kept as far away as possible.
sentences.zh: 政府里有很多人把她视为一颗定时炸弹，认为她极其危险，应该离她越远越好。

sentences.en: So the other day, there was a hit piece about me.
sentences.zh: 所以前几天，有一篇针对我的抹黑文章。

sentences.en: They obviously talked to some people at the White House.
sentences.zh: 他们显然跟白宫的一些人聊过。

sentences.en: And it said, Trump's staff are getting tired of Laura Loomer.
sentences.zh: 上面写着，特朗普的工作人员开始对劳拉·鲁默感到厌烦了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: But grouping her in the same bucket as other influencers or other social media trolls or anything like that, it's kind of a mistake because she isn't like them.
sentences.zh: 但把她和其它网红、社交媒体水军之类的人归为一类，其实是一种错误，因为她跟他们不一样。

sentences.en: She doesn't go to their parties.
sentences.zh: 她不参加他们的派对。

sentences.en: She doesn't live in a mansion.
sentences.zh: 她不住在大豪宅里。

sentences.en: She lives in a little rental house in the Gulf Coast of Florida.
sentences.zh: 她住在佛罗里达州墨西哥湾沿岸的一栋小租屋里。

sentences.en: And she spends all day on the phone trying to find dirt on people and trying to make noise.
sentences.zh: 她整天都在打电话，试图挖出别人的黑料，制造轰动。

sentences.en: Well, why would I give a shit about what they think about me when I play for an audience of one?
sentences.zh: 好吧，当我的受众只有一个人时，我凭什么要在乎他们怎么看我？

sentences.en: She has a singular mission that is truly, I think, unique in this sphere.
sentences.zh: 她有一个独特的目标，在这个领域里可以说是绝无仅有的。

sentences.en: And it sets her apart.
sentences.zh: 这使她与众不同。

sentences.en: And it is the mission that motivates her and keeps her going every day.
sentences.zh: 正是这个目标激励着她，支撑着她日复一日地坚持下去。

sentences.en: And it is the thing that makes people wake up in the middle of the night with a cold sweat.
sentences.zh: 这也是让人半夜惊醒、冷汗直冒的东西。

sentences.en: And just to be clear, that mission is defending Trump at all costs.
sentences.zh: 顺便明确一下，这个目标就是不惜一切代价捍卫特朗普。

sentences.en: That's it.
sentences.zh: 就这么简单。

sentences.en: That's the one goal she has in mind.
sentences.zh: 这就是她脑海中唯一的目的。

sentences.en: And it is all she knows how to do.
sentences.zh: 这也是她唯一擅长做的事。

sentences.en: And I don't think she's capable of imagining anything else that she'd want to do, nor is there anything she would really trade it for, I think, at this point.
sentences.zh: 我觉得她想象不出自己还想做别的什么，而且在目前这个阶段，也没有什么东西是她愿意用来交换的。

sentences.en: At the end of the day, the only person that really matters is Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 归根结底，真正重要的人只有唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: She is his perfect blunt instrument that can do the jobs that no one else will get done.
sentences.zh: 她是唐纳德完美的直率工具，能够完成别人不愿去做的脏活累活。

sentences.en: In exchange, what she gets out of this is the approval and acceptance of Donald J.
sentences.zh: 作为回报，她从中得到的是唐纳德·J·特朗普的赞同与认可。

sentences.en: Trump.
sentences.zh: 特朗普。

sentences.en: Ken, thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 肯，非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thank you, Natalie.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，娜塔莉。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, Israel approved new settlements in the West Bank, fragmenting land that had been envisioned as part of a Palestinian state.
sentences.zh: 周三，以色列批准在约旦河西岸建设新的定居点，这进一步分裂了原本被构想为巴勒斯坦国领土的土地。

sentences.en: Under the plan, 3,400 additional housing units would be built in one of the most sensitive areas of the West Bank, near Jerusalem.
sentences.zh: 根据该计划，将在约旦河西岸最敏感的地区之一（靠近耶路撒冷）增建3400套住房。

sentences.en: At the same time, the Israeli military moved ahead with plans to take over Gaza City, saying its troops had advanced to the city's outskirts.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，以色列军队推进了接管加沙城的计划，称其部队已推进至该市郊区。

sentences.en: Tents were being moved into southern Gaza for people who would be displaced from their homes.
sentences.zh: 帐篷正被运往加沙南部，供那些从家园流离失所的人居住。

sentences.en: Together, the moves raised questions about whether a new ceasefire proposal for the war in Gaza had any chance of moving forward.
sentences.zh: 这些举措加剧了人们对加沙战争的新停火提议是否有任何推进可能的质疑。

sentences.en: And on Wednesday, after weeks of partisan fighting, the Texas House passed a new congressional map that delivered President Trump the gerrymandering he'd asked for.
sentences.zh: 周三，经过数周的党派争斗，德克萨斯州众议院通过了一张新的国会选区地图，为特朗普总统实现了他要求的选区划分。

sentences.en: The goal was to clinch five new Republican seats in the House next year.
sentences.zh: 此举的目标是在明年的众议院选举中稳操胜券，多赢得五个共和党席位。

sentences.en: The state Senate is expected to vote on the map as soon as Thursday evening and would then send it to Governor Greg Abbott for his promised signature.
sentences.zh: 预计州参议院最快将于周四晚上对该地图进行投票，随后将其提交给州长格雷格·阿博特，由他签署此前承诺过的法案。

sentences.zh: 今天的节目由罗布·济普科、凯特琳·奥基夫和阿斯塔·查塔维迪制作。

sentences.zh: 由蕾切尔·奎斯特剪辑，克里斯·伍德进行音频工程制作。

sentences.zh: 特别感谢阿什利·卡洛威-布拉奇和达娜·格林。

sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.zh: 我是娜塔莉·基特罗维斯。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器在运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了大批自封为改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 自那以后，该党便陷入了一场激烈、混乱、有时甚至扣人心弦的权力之争中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在《都市》最新一期节目中，我和萨拉·科尼格将带您了解那些试图维持影响力却最终失去控制的人的故事。

sentences.zh: 《都市》。
